scope: Offline reading/token counting/arithmetic only. No benchmark, model calls, runtime changes or new judgments.
tokenizer: Locally cached o200k_base; proxy model tokenizer not verified. Estimated tokens are not provider usage.
method: Conservative baseline fix: only remove unrequested/unmodified first-action operator blocks whose complete result object is identical before and after the question; retain a short unchanged-error list.
Error-scope fix: remove successful table blocks from rejected calls with omitted/empty observe; counted separately from normal baseline fixes.
First appearances priced as cache writes; repeats as cache reads. Assumes stable-prefix reuse, same action sequence, same output tokens, and no added model calls.
History savings are scenarios (10/20/30% of history token content), not a measured full-history compression implementation.
No cost benefit is credited for fewer calls, fewer observed parent tables, or higher accuracy.
